!1 End-to-End Event-Driven Test

!2 Prerequisites

Ensure the local environment is running (docker-compose up) and
OpenTofu has been applied (infra/ directory).

!2 Imports

| import |
| com.example.fixtures |

!2 Option A: Publish Raw JSON via SqsPublishFixture

| script        | SqsPublishFixture                                                         |
| setQueueUrl   | http://localhost:4566/000000000000/event-ingress-queue                    |
| setMessageBody | {"id":"txn-001","amount":49.99,"description":"test purchase","timestamp":"2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"} |
| $messageId=   | publish                                                                   |

!2 Option B: Publish via JteTemplate (JTE-generated SQS event)

| script          | JteSqsPublishFixture                                                    |
| setQueueUrl     | http://localhost:4566/000000000000/event-ingress-queue                  |
| setTransactionId| txn-002                                                                 |
| setAmount       | 149.99                                                                  |
| setDescription  | JTE-generated purchase                                                  |
| $messageId2=    | publish                                                                 |

!3 Verify Lambda 1 (SQS -> S3) via CloudWatch Logs

| script          | CloudWatchLogsFixture                               |
| setLogGroupName | /aws/lambda/sqs-to-s3-processor                     |
| setFilterPattern | "Successfully wrote event"                          |
| check           | logContains                                         | $messageId  |
| check           | logContains                                         | $messageId2 |
| show            | matchingMessages                                    |

!3 Verify Lambda 2 (S3 -> DB) via CloudWatch Logs

| script          | CloudWatchLogsFixture                               |
| setLogGroupName | /aws/lambda/s3-to-db-loader                         |
| setFilterPattern | "Successfully inserted transaction"                 |
| check           | logContains                                         | txn-001     |
| check           | logContains                                         | txn-002     |
| show            | matchingMessages                                    |

!3 Verify Record in PostgreSQL

| script  | ExistsInDB          |
| setTable| transactions        |
| setColumn| id                  |
| check   | exists              | txn-001 |
| check   | exists              | txn-002 |

!3 Health Check via HTTP

| script | FetchByHttpGetCall                |
| setUrl | http://localhost:4566/_localstack/health |
| show   | statusCode                        |
